SBS Custom Style
****************

A standalone backend experience suite for Odoo 19 Community. It combines a
responsive apps sidebar, configurable light and dark colors, chatter and dialog
preferences, grouped-list controls, and manual or automated view refresh.

Features
--------

* Responsive application sidebar and app menu.
* Company branding with a custom logo, favicon, and background.
* Configurable light, dark, apps-menu, and sidebar colors.
* User-selectable chatter position.
* User-selectable default dialog size with quick expand and restore controls.
* Login background customization using a colour or uploaded image.
* Expand-all and collapse-all controls for grouped list views.
* Manual, interval-based, and automation-triggered view refresh.
* German, Spanish, French, and Italian translations.

Compatibility
-------------

This module supports Odoo 19 Community only. It intentionally excludes
``web_enterprise`` and has no dependency on an external theme add-on.
